name: fomo-limit-orders
title: Order Flow
description: An 18.5-second trading-interface demo with fictional data, graphite surfaces and amber controls: three opening lines over drifting bars, a phone with a position card that the camera pushes into and orbits, a limit-order ticket whose slider contracts into a price field, a confirmation card, and the closing wordmark. Silent: sound is added by the host. All figures are illustrative.
useWhen: You want a complete trading-interface demo built from editable layers.
You need close-up UI choreography, a slider morph, and an order confirmation.
avoidWhen: You need a general product launch story: use launch-anything.
You only need a text transition: use word-push.
author: Remocn
